dct_creator_sm: Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) / Environnement et Changement climatique Canada (ECCC).
dct_description_sm: Long-term freshwater quality monitoring data for over six sites in the Yukon River Basin for the past 15 years or longer for nutrients, metals, major ions, and other physical-chemical variables are included in this dataset. Monitoring is conducted by Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) and in partnership with Environment Yukon to assess water quality status and long-term trends, detect emerging issues, establish water quality guidelines and track the effectiveness of remedial measures and regulatory decisions. Part of the Canada Long-term Water Quality Monitoring Dataset
dct_title_s: Yukon River Basin Long-term Water Quality Monitoring Data
